title: Gravel Was Built in America But UCI Worlds Aren’t Coming Any Time Soon
content:
UCI-sanctioned gravel worlds won't be hitting the USA until at least 2032 as India lands road worlds, Benidorm gets cyclocross, and Mont-Sainte-Anne scores MTB.

Read the full article at Gravel Was Built in America But UCI Worlds Aren’t Coming Any Time Soon on Velo.
